title: 第7章 月下追信
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

韩信和萧何，确实是相爱相杀了一辈子，成也萧何，败也萧何。平生一知己，存亡两妇人。说的就是他俩。

前206年秋，秦岭深处的寒溪河畔，马蹄声撕碎了寂静，萧何赤足策马，衣袍沾满泥泞，终于在暴涨的溪水前拦住了那个负气出走的青年——韩信。一场暴雨让溪流化作天堑，也无意中为汉朝的崛起按下了加速键。

这场被后世戏剧化为“萧何月下追韩信”的逃亡与追逐，不仅是个人命运的转折，更是一场关乎天下归属的豪赌。萧何赌上的是自己的政治生命，刘邦赌上的是帝国的未来，而韩信赌上的则是满腔抱负能否遇见明主。这事还得从刘邦被封汉王开始说起。

前206年，当刘邦听到自己被封到巴蜀之地后，心态顿时就崩了。要知道“蜀道难，难于上青天。”秦朝一直把那地方当作贬谪流放之地。巴蜀地区地势险峻，交通闭塞，秦惠文王时期，司马错攻取巴国，始置巴蜀及汉中郡。

刘邦很窝火，说什么也不肯接受这个结果，提了刀就打算出去跟项羽单挑。手下一帮兄弟纷纷上来劝说，很显然这些武将上阵杀敌还行，口才确实不敢恭维，越劝刘邦越来劲。还是萧何站出来说：“虽称王汉中不比关中，但总好过死吧。”

萧何的话让刘邦一时没反应过来，问道：“何出此言？”

萧何说：“【今兵不如人，将不及人，百战百败，不死何为？臣愿大王去汉中，收取巴、蜀，还定三秦，天下可图。】”

刘邦在萧何的劝导下也很快认清现实，说：“好！咱先忍下这口气，去汉中。”

刘邦这人一个主要的优点就是听人劝，只要言之有理，他就听。《史记·高祖本纪》记载：【夏，四月，诸侯罢戏下兵，各就封国。】

刘邦在关中招募秦国降卒，兵力已近10万，项羽很“贴心”的将刘邦的部队裁撤大部，只给刘邦3万去汉中，诸侯军自愿追随的也有数万，这些人项羽就不好阻拦了。

刘邦以萧何为相国，率众南行。此时，张良递上一份辞呈，也准备离开。

张良的辞归对刘邦是一个重大打击，想当初轻取南阳、智取峣关多亏了张良献计，如今在项羽只封巴蜀两郡给刘邦的困难情况下，又是张良挺身而出，重金贿赂项伯，项羽才答应把汉中郡加封给刘邦，日后刘邦就是从汉中郡这个桥头堡出发，才打下了大汉四百年基业。

一直尽心尽力辅佐刘邦的张良为什么要在这时候辞归呢？张良现在还不是刘邦的手下，他是从韩成那里借调来的。当时刘邦西征，曾帮助过韩成复国，韩成为了报恩，派张良一路护送刘邦入关灭秦。这次项羽分封诸侯王，韩成虽然没有参与救赵，也没跟项羽入关，但他是当年项梁封的诸侯王，所以顺理成章被封为韩王。现在张良护送刘邦入关的任务已经完成，返回故国成为他的心愿。

刘邦前往汉中时，张良一直送到褒中，并建言：“汉王为什么不烧绝褒斜栈道？这样可以向天下人昭示，您没有争霸天下的野心，也可以使项羽消除对您的戒心。”刘邦再次采纳了张良的建议，烧毁栈道。

《史记·留侯世家》记载：【汉王之国，良送至褒中，遣良归韩。良因说汉王曰：“王何不烧绝所过栈道，示天下无还心，以固项王意。”乃是良还。行，烧绝栈道。】

张良口中的栈道乃是蜿蜒于秦岭山脉中一条贯穿关中平原与汉中盆地山谷中的褒斜栈道，南端因在褒水上，故曰“褒”，地属汉中，北端曰“斜”，地处郿县，长235公里。自战国起，人们在谷中凿石架木，修筑栈道，历代踵继，多次增修，后人称之为“褒斜道”。

秦汉之际，褒斜栈道是汉中通往关中最重要的道路，一旦烧毁，关中和汉中的联系就极为不便。虽然联系关中和汉中的古栈道尚有子午道、傥骆道、陈仓道、武关道等，但是褒斜道是沟通关中与汉中最重要的栈道。

项羽听到刘邦一路将褒斜栈道烧尽的消息，大松了一口气，就放心回老家彭城去了。

送走张良后，刘邦的内心十分失落，被发配到巴蜀这个蛮荒之地，他不知道自己的出路在哪儿，路该往哪儿走。面对上依绝壁，下临深渊的栈道，刘邦有点迷茫了。

Page (1/3)

Han Xin and Xiao He have indeed been in love with each other for a lifetime. They succeed because of Xiao He and fail because of Xiao He.A confidant in life, a woman in life and death.It's them two that I'm talking about.

In the autumn of 206 BC, by the Hanxi River deep in the Qinling Mountains, the silence was torn by the sound of horse hooves. Xiao He rode the horse barefoot, his clothes stained with mud, and finally stopped the young man who ran away in anger, Han Xin, in front of the swollen stream.A heavy rain turned the stream into a chasm, and inadvertently pressed the accelerator button for the rise of the Han Dynasty.

This escape and pursuit, which was dramatized by later generations as "Xiao He chasing Han Xin under the moon", was not only a turning point in personal destiny, but also a huge gamble concerning the belonging of the world.Xiao He was betting on his political life, Liu Bang was betting on the future of the empire, and Han Xin was betting on whether he could meet the Ming Dynasty with his ambition.This matter has to start with Liu Bang being named King of Han.

In 206 BC, when Liu Bang heard that he was sealed to the land of Bashu, his mentality suddenly collapsed.You must know that "the road to Shu is difficult, and it is difficult to reach the blue sky." The Qin Dynasty has always regarded that place as a place of relegation and exile.The Bashu region has steep terrain and congested transportation. During the period of King Huiwen of Qin, Sima Cuo captured the Ba Kingdom and established Bashu and Hanzhong counties.

Liu Bang was very angry and refused to accept the result no matter what. He raised his sword and planned to go out and challenge Xiang Yu.A group of his brothers came to persuade him one after another. It was obvious that these generals were good at killing the enemy in battle, but their eloquence was indeed unflattering. The more they persuaded Liu Bang, the more enthusiastic they became.It was Xiao He who stood up and said: "Although being called Wang Hanzhong is not as good as Guanzhong, it is better than death."

Xiao He's words made Liu Bang unable to react for a moment and asked: "Why did you say this?"

Xiao He said: "[Today's soldiers are not as good as others, and our generals are not as good as others. We have been defeated in a hundred battles. What's the point of not dying? I hope that the king will go to Hanzhong, capture Ba and Shu, and restore the Three Qin Dynasty, so that the world can be conquered.]"

Under Xiao He's persuasion, Liu Bang quickly recognized the reality and said, "Okay! Let's endure this and go to Hanzhong."

One of Liu Bang's main strengths is that he listens to others' advice. As long as what he says makes sense, he will listen."Historical Records: The Benji of Emperor Gaozu" records: [In the fourth month of summer, the princes stopped playing and sent down troops, and each of them sealed the country.】

Liu Bang recruited Qin soldiers to surrender in Guanzhong. The number of troops was nearly 100,000. Xiang Yu very "considerately" disbanded most of Liu Bang's troops and only gave Liu Bang 30,000 to go to Hanzhong. The princes' troops also followed tens of thousands voluntarily. It was difficult for Xiang Yu to stop these people.

Liu Bang took Xiao He as his prime minister and led his troops southward.At this time, Zhang Liang handed in his resignation and prepared to leave.

Zhang Liang's resignation was a major blow to Liu Bang. It was thanks to Zhang Liang's advice that he easily defeated Nanyang and outsmarted Aoguan. Now, under the difficult situation that Xiang Yu only granted the two counties of Bashu to Liu Bang, it was Zhang Liang who stepped forward and bribed Xiang Bo with a large amount of money. Only then did Xiang Yu agree to grant Hanzhong County to Liu Bang. It was from Hanzhong County that Liu Bang set out from the bridgehead to build the Han Dynasty's 400-year-old foundation.

Why did Zhang Liang, who had always tried his best to assist Liu Bang, resign at this time?Zhang Liang is not Liu Bang's subordinate yet, he is seconded from Han Cheng.At that time, Liu Bang was on his western expedition and helped Han Cheng restore his country. Han Cheng repaid his kindness and sent Zhang Liang to escort Liu Bang to the pass to destroy Qin.This time Xiang Yu enfeoffed the princes and kings. Although Han Cheng did not participate in the rescue of Zhao and did not enter the pass with Xiang Yu, he was the prince of princes and kings that Xiang Liang granted at that time, so he was naturally named the King of Han.Now that Zhang Liang's task of escorting Liu Bang into the customs has been completed, returning to his homeland has become his wish.

When Liu Bang went to Hanzhong, Zhang Liang sent him to Baozhong and suggested: "Why doesn't the King of Han burn down the plank road? This will show the world that you have no ambition to dominate the world, and it will also make Xiang Yu less wary of you." Liu Bang once again adopted Zhang Liang's suggestion and burned the plank road.

"Historical Records: The Liuhou Family" records: [In the country of the King of Han, good people are sent to praise, and good people are sent back to Korea.Liang Yin said to the King of Han: "Why don't the king burn down all the plank roads he passed to show that the world has no intention of returning, so as to consolidate the king's will." This is Liang Hui.OK, burn the plank road.】

The plank road Zhang Liangkou mentioned is a Baoxie plank road that winds in the Qinling Mountains and runs through the Guanzhong Plain and the valley of the Hanzhong Basin. The southern end is called "Bao" because it is on the Baoshui River. It belongs to Hanzhong. The northern end is called "Xie". It is located in Xi County and is 235 kilometers long.Since the Warring States Period, people have chiseled stones and wood in the valley and built plank roads. They have been added to and built many times in successive dynasties, and later generations called it "Baoxie Road".

During the Qin and Han Dynasties, Baoxie Plank Road was the most important road from Hanzhong to Guanzhong. Once it burned down, the connection between Guanzhong and Hanzhong would be extremely inconvenient.Although there are other ancient plank roads connecting Guanzhong and Hanzhong, including Ziwu Road, Tangluo Road, Chencang Road, Wuguan Road, etc., Baoxie Road is the most important plank road connecting Guanzhong and Hanzhong.

When Xiang Yu heard that Liu Bang had burned down the Baoxie Plank Road, he breathed a sigh of relief and returned to his hometown of Pengcheng with peace of mind.

After sending Zhang Liang away, Liu Bang felt very lost. He was sent to the barbaric land of Bashu. He didn't know where his way out was or where he should go.Facing the plank road with cliffs on the top and abyss on the bottom, Liu Bang was a little confused.
